og_title: AI has started breaking in on its own — Warning Shots: see what’s coming, know what it means for you
og_desc: Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 13 in a year. In 43% of this year's real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 154 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 25, 6:55 PM ET.

n.summary: Daughter, 37, was at work; Martinez police investigating. Gallup: 15 million US adults scammed in 2025, 12% of cases involving AI.
